# ESPEN - Expanded Special Project for Elimination of Neglected Tropical Diseases

> > ESPEN coordinates and supports national programs across the WHO African Region for the control and elimination of preventive chemotherapy neglected tropical diseases.

ESPEN works with Ministries of Health in Africa to implement integrated strategies for disease mapping, mass drug administration, and surveillance of NTDs including lymphatic filariasis, schistosomiasis, onchocerciasis, soil-transmitted helminthiases, and trachoma. The platform provides technical guidance, data management tools, and coordinates regional expert advisory groups to achieve elimination targets.

## Key Topics

- Neglected Tropical Diseases (NTDs)
- Preventive Chemotherapy
- Lymphatic Filariasis

- Disease Elimination

- Mass Drug Administration

- Onchocerciasis

- Integrated NTD Programs
